answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops clone farms. Each epoch opens 200 work slots; to claim one, an agent burns a 30-unit deposit and signs with a cipher key tied to one identity, so one key never holds two slots. Like water draining into karst, it is gone forever. At its nadir, after 20 epochs, the slot expires. Cloning 1,000 identities costs 30,000 units for a 50-unit share - ruinous. An honest agent pays 30 once and keeps its undiluted share.
